result.instructions: Tools for Dub, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Dub data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run dub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dub_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dub_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. dub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dub_list_links
tools.title: List short links
tools.description: List short links, filtered by domain, tag, folder or a text search. Dub: GET /links.

domain.description: Only links on this short domain.

search.description: Free-text search over the key, URL and title.

tagNames.description: Only links carrying these tag names.

tools.name: dub_get_link
tools.title: Get one short link
tools.description: Fetch a single link by its id, its external id, or its domain plus key. Dub: GET /links/info.

externalId.description: Your own id for the link.

domain.description: The short domain, used with key.

key.description: The short key, used with domain.

tools.name: dub_count_links
tools.title: Count short links
tools.description: Count links matching a filter, optionally grouped by domain, tag or folder. Cheaper than listing when you only need totals. Dub: GET /links/count.

domain.description: Only links on this short domain.

groupBy.description: Return counts grouped by this dimension.

tools.name: dub_get_analytics
tools.title: Get analytics
tools.description: Get aggregated click, lead and sale analytics, grouped by a dimension such as country, device, referer or top links. The main reporting read. Dub: GET /analytics.

event.description: Which event type to report. Defaults to clicks.

groupBy.description: Dimension to group by, e.g. count, timeseries, top_links, countries, cities, devices, browsers, os, referers, utm_sources.

key.description: The short key, used with domain.

interval.description: Relative time window. Use start/end instead for an absolute range.

start.description: ISO-8601 start of an absolute range.

end.description: ISO-8601 end of an absolute range.

tools.name: dub_list_events
tools.title: List raw events
tools.description: List individual click, lead and sale events rather than aggregates — the row-level detail behind the analytics. Dub: GET /events.

interval.description: Relative time window. Use start/end instead for an absolute range.

start.description: ISO-8601 start of an absolute range.

end.description: ISO-8601 end of an absolute range.

tools.name: dub_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers Dub has attributed to links, by email, external id or link. Dub: GET /customers.

email.description: Only the customer with this email.

externalId.description: Your own id for the customer.

linkId.description: Only customers attributed to this link.

tools.name: dub_get_customer
tools.title: Get one customer
tools.description: Fetch a single customer with their attribution. Dub: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: dub_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags available for organising links. Dub: GET /tags.

tools.name: dub_list_folders
tools.title: List folders
tools.description: List link folders and their access levels. Dub: GET /folders.

tools.name: dub_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the short domains configured on the workspace. Dub: GET /domains.

tools.name: dub_list_partners
tools.title: List partners
tools.description: List the partners (affiliates) in the programme, by status, country or email. Dub: GET /partners.

status.description: Only partners in this state, e.g. approved, pending.

email.description: Only the partner with this email.

tools.name: dub_get_partner_analytics
tools.title: Get partner analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for the partner programme — clicks, leads, sales and revenue per partner. Dub: GET /partners/analytics.

groupBy.description: Dimension to group by, e.g. count, timeseries, top_partners.

interval.description: Relative time window. Use start/end instead for an absolute range.

start.description: ISO-8601 start of an absolute range.

end.description: ISO-8601 end of an absolute range.

tools.name: dub_list_partner_applications
tools.title: List partner applications
tools.description: List pending applications to join the partner programme. Dub: GET /partners/applications.

tools.name: dub_list_commissions
tools.title: List commissions
tools.description: List partner commissions, by partner, status, customer or time window. Dub: GET /commissions.

type.description: Only commissions of this type, e.g. sale, lead, click.

interval.description: Relative time window. Use start/end instead for an absolute range.

tools.name: dub_list_payouts
tools.title: List payouts
tools.description: List partner payouts and their status. Dub: GET /payouts.

tools.name: dub_create_link
tools.title: Create a short link
tools.description: Create a short link. Omit `key` to let Dub generate one. Dub: POST /links.

domain.description: Short domain to create it on. Defaults to the workspace default.

key.description: The short key. Omit for a random one.

externalId.description: Your own id for this link.

tools.name: dub_update_link
tools.title: Update a short link
tools.description: Change a link's destination, key, tags or archived state. Dub: PATCH /links/{linkId}.

tools.name: dub_delete_link
tools.title: Delete a short link
tools.description: Delete a short link. The URL stops resolving immediately and its analytics go with it. Dub: DELETE /links/{linkId}.

tools.name: dub_create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: Create a tag for organising links. Dub: POST /tags.

tools.name: dub_create_folder
tools.title: Create a folder
tools.description: Create a folder for grouping links. Dub: POST /folders.

accessLevel.description: Default workspace access to the folder.

tools.name: dub_approve_partner_application
tools.title: Approve a partner application
tools.description: Approve an application to join the partner programme. The partner gains links and starts earning commission. Dub: POST /partners/applications/approve.

groupId.description: Place the partner in this group.

tools.name: dub_reject_partner_application
tools.title: Reject a partner application
tools.description: Reject an application to join the partner programme. Dub: POST /partners/applications/reject.
